date_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_low.text: *The bench by the fountain is empty. A message from Seoyeon arrives a moment later.* I don't think we should meet alone today. I'll see you at school next week.

date_yuna_low.name: Yuna
date_yuna_low.text: *Yuna is already outside the café. She adjusts her bag strap and takes a step back.* I don't think we should spend a long time alone right now. Let's stop here for today.

date_dain_low.name: Dain
date_dain_low.text: *Outside the gym, Dain adjusts the strap of her ball bag.* I'm not in the mood to hang out today. See you at school.

date_seo_1.name: {name}
date_seo_1.text: *Seoyeon is already waiting by the fountain. There is no clipboard, only the bag strap wound around her fingers.*

date_seo_compliment_choice.name: {name}
date_seo_compliment_choice.text: *Seoyeon winds the strap of her bag around one finger again.*
choices: You went all out today, huh.
Of course the student council president plans a flawless date, too.

date_seo_pretty_high.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_high.text: *The bag strap loosens in the hand gripping it.*

date_seo_pretty_high_2.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_high_2.text: *She turns her gaze toward the sound of the fountain.* Let's get some air.

date_seo_pretty_high_3_b.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_high_3_b.text: *She readjusts her grip on the bag strap.* Enough.

date_seo_pretty_high_4.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_high_4.text: *The hair tucked behind her ear falls loose again. Her rising hand returns to the bag strap.*

date_seo_pretty_low.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_low.text: Where did that come from? Warn me before you say things like that.

date_seo_bright.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_bright.text: Of course. I put in a little effort today.

date_seo_walk.name: {name}
date_seo_walk.text: *We walk through the park. We toss bread to the ducks.*

date_seo_duck.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_duck.text: They're simple, these guys. Give them bread, they follow. No bread, they couldn't care less.

date_seo_duck_2.name: {name}
date_seo_duck_2.text: People aren't that different, are they?

date_seo_duck_3.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_duck_3.text: People sometimes don't come, even when you give them bread.

date_seo_duck_4.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_duck_4.text: *She watches the bread crumbs sink by the water. Her steps slow in front of the flower shop.*

date_seo_flower_b.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_flower_b.text: *She turns her toes toward the flower shop's glass door.* Want to go in?

date_seo_flower_2.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_flower_2.text: *A bell chimes when she pushes open the flower-shop door. Seoyeon circles the displays once and chooses a small potted succulent.*

date_seo_succulent_2.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_succulent_2.text: This one's easy. Survives even if you forget to water it.

date_seo_succulent_3.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_succulent_3.text: If you can keep it alive. — If not, I'm taking it back.

date_seo_end.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_end.text: *She holds out the potted plant. Its small, soil-filled weight settles into my palm.*

date_seo_end_b.name: {name}
date_seo_end_b.text: *We leave the park and walk down the street.*

date_seo_end_c.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_end_c.text: *The wrapping around the pot rustles softly in her hand.* Today.

date_seo_end_d.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_end_d.text: I had a good time today.

date_yuna_1.name: {name}
date_yuna_1.text: *Outside the café, Yuna leans against the wall in a black dress with a small crossbody bag. Without her school uniform, the lines of her tattoos catch my eye first.*

date_yuna_compliment_choice.name: {name}
date_yuna_compliment_choice.text: *Yuna's eyes briefly rise over the rim of her cup.*
choices: First time I'm seeing you out of uniform.
You look a little different today.
You look much easier to talk to than usual.

date_yuna_pretty_high.name: Yuna
date_yuna_pretty_high.text: *She stares at the rim of the cup for a long time. Silver-white hair slips down beside her cheek.*

date_yuna_pretty_high_5_c.name: Yuna
date_yuna_pretty_high_5_c.text: *Her thumb sweeps the condensation from the cup lid.* Enough.

date_yuna_pretty_low.name: Yuna
date_yuna_pretty_low.text: I'm not used to hearing things like that.

date_yuna_bookstore.name: {name}
date_yuna_bookstore.text: *We head to a bookstore. Yuna walks slowly between the shelves.*

date_yuna_bookstore_3.name: Yuna
date_yuna_bookstore_3.text: Good. So I get to be the first one who showed you this place.

date_yuna_earphone.name: Yuna
date_yuna_earphone.text: *She hands me one of her earbuds.*

date_yuna_earphone_2_b.name: {name}
date_yuna_earphone_2_b.text: *A quiet piano piece flows in. The noise of the bookstore fades away.*

date_yuna_earphone_3.name: {name}
date_yuna_earphone_3.text: *The earbud cord sets the distance between us. Yuna sits exactly that close.*

date_yuna_oldbook.name: {name}
date_yuna_oldbook.text: *Two steps past a secondhand bookshop, Yuna turns back.*

date_yuna_oldbook_c.name: {name}
date_yuna_oldbook_c.text: *She pulls out an old book and flips through the pages.*

date_yuna_oldbook_2.name: Yuna
date_yuna_oldbook_2.text: I read this a year ago. Back then, the ending felt sad.

date_yuna_end.name: Yuna
date_yuna_end.text: *She looks at {name}. The corner of the page folds beneath her fingers.*

date_yuna_end_b.name: Yuna
date_yuna_end_b.text: *Just before we leave the bookstore, she hands me a note instead of speaking.*

date_yuna_end_c.name: {name}
date_yuna_end_c.text: *'I talked a lot today. Because I was with you.' The lavender ink smudges slightly on the final character.*

date_dain_1.name: {name}
date_dain_1.text: *Outside the gym, Dain runs up in a cap and athletic wear.*

date_dain_2.name: Dain
date_dain_2.text: You're here! Almost late, weren't you?

date_dain_3.name: {name}
date_dain_3.text: I got here ten minutes early.

date_dain_4.name: Dain
date_dain_4.text: I got here twenty minutes early!

date_dain_compliment_choice.name: {name}
date_dain_compliment_choice.text: *Dain presses down the brim of her cap once and waits.*
choices: That cap looks good on you.

date_dain_pretty_high.name: Dain
date_dain_pretty_high.text: *Dain pulls her cap low enough to hide half her face.*

date_dain_pretty_high_2.name: Dain
date_dain_pretty_high_2.text: Hey, don't say things like that out of nowhere.

date_dain_pretty_high_4.name: Dain
date_dain_pretty_high_4.text: *The tips of her ears redden beneath the brim. Her fingers remain hooked over its edge.*

date_dain_pretty_low.name: Dain
date_dain_pretty_low.text: What brought that on? Thanks, though.

date_dain_bright.name: Dain
date_dain_bright.text: *Dain's smile pauses as she tugs the brim lower.* ...Right. Sportswear is comfortable.

date_dain_arcade.name: {name}
date_dain_arcade.text: *We stand in front of a rhythm game machine. The screen flickers.*

date_dain_arcade_2.name: Dain
date_dain_arcade_2.text: All right, another bet. Loser buys the drinks!

date_dain_arcade_3_b.name: {name}
date_dain_arcade_3_b.text: *As soon as the rhythm game starts, Dain catches the beat. Her combo never breaks before the song ends.*

date_dain_arcade_3_c.name: Dain
date_dain_arcade_3_c.text: *She jumps to her feet.* Full combo! Did you see that?

date_dain_rhythm.name: Dain
date_dain_rhythm.text: *She points at the score on the screen.* That's my second-highest score ever.

date_dain_rhythm_3.name: Dain
date_dain_rhythm_3.text: Obviously. This doesn't use my knees.

date_dain_knee.name: {name}
date_dain_knee.text: *“Because I don't have to use my knees.” Dain laughs at the end, then glances once at her right knee reflected in the window.*

date_dain_knee_2.name: {name}
date_dain_knee_2.text: *We leave the arcade and pass a sporting-goods store. Dain slows in front of a window displaying volleyball shoes.*

date_dain_shop.name: Dain
date_dain_shop.text: *Her eyes trace the laces of the volleyball shoes behind the glass. Beneath her cap, her lips press together.*

date_dain_shop_2_b.name: Dain
date_dain_shop_2_b.text: *She turns her chin toward the other side of the display.* It's nothing! Let's go!

date_dain_shop_3.name: Dain
date_dain_shop_3.text: *She shoves both hands into her pockets and walks ahead.* Don't stare.

date_dain_shop_3_b.name: Dain
date_dain_shop_3_b.text: *She lengthens her stride.* Ask me one more time and I'm seriously leaving without you.

date_dain_end.name: {name}
date_dain_end.text: *She is smiling. Under the brim of her cap, her gaze stays on the shop window.*

date_dain_end_c.name: Dain
date_dain_end_c.text: I had fun today. I mean it.

pre_confess_minsu.name: Minsu
pre_confess_minsu.text: yo you on your date right? one thing

pre_confess_minsu_2.name: Minsu
pre_confess_minsu_2.text: don't dodge it. do it properly

pre_confess_callback.name: {name}
pre_confess_callback.text: *The corner of the phone in my pocket presses into my palm. There are no notifications, only black glass reflected on the screen.*

date_seo_role_trap.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_role_trap.text: *Her hand leaves the bag strap.* I'm not here as the student council president today.

date_yuna_trap.name: Yuna
date_yuna_trap.text: So I am usually hard to approach.
